limits: The existing 135-position primary edition keeps its 21-position technical span unassigned. This supplement changes no accepted record count or primary status.

All 270 transmitted source slots are retained. The DD pair is excluded only from the optional plaintext-pairing stream, then restored before the original 270-slot transposition in every complete forward witness.

The source shows no cancellation of the two D coordinates, and they are far apart in transmitted order. The historical stage of a possible error is not established. A spurious plaintext W and a surplus DD coordinate pair before transposition are observationally equivalent here.

The fixed target was selected by inspecting the raw technical phrase and ordinary language. Unique minimum cost among 36,315 two-coordinate removals is conditional on that target and error family, not independent proof, a calibrated probability, or a uniqueness claim over all historical readings.
The 1900 lexical witness attests the adjective in railway usage only. It neither repeats this telegram nor proves the intended office or word.
The raw numeral 8 is explicitly changed to N inside the proposed technical word at one observed-coordinate substitution. It is not reassigned in the key. The reference 474D remains unchanged.
No new key or first historical decipherment is claimed; the unchanged published Oct4-6 key retains prior attribution.
